FY2026-2031 is a decomposition of the Town's own known aggregate by FY2025 share (ties out exactly); FY2032-2040 is where each category's own rate diverges from a single blended rate.
schools_assumption: Category-level build: sum of 9 DESE function categories, each grown at its own 16yr trailing CAGR from the real FY2025 Schedule A anchor - see schools_category_forecast_fy26_40_methodology.md (not the Town's FY26-31 figure, even for FY2026-2031 - trend_corrected is this project's own independent estimate throughout, same principle as Phase 1's revenue forecast)
benefits_assumption: Category-level build: Pensions (real 2024 ADC schedule through FY2031, then 3.0%/yr payroll-growth proxy), Group Health (25yr reconstructed trend), OPEB (Town's real FY26-31 schedule incl. the pension/OPEB handoff, held flat FY2032-2040), Other (Town-implied CAGR) - see benefits_category_forecast_fy26_40_methodology.md
other_nondept_assumption: special_appropriations_cip (below, now formula-grown) + nondept_general/reserve_fund/non_appropriated held flat at FY2031 (no defensible independent trend for those three)
debt_service_excluded_assumption: held flat at FY2031 - no new debt exclusions assumed (matches revenue side)
debt_service_regular_assumption: 6.6% CIP Financing Policy: 3.95% of prior-year Net Revenue (Total Revenue - Debt Exclusions - Free Cash - Non-Appropriations), per FY2027 Financial Plan p.352/384 - see methodology doc (realized FY27-32 average from the real CIP funding table, not the stated 4.5% target)
special_appropriations_cip_assumption: revenue_financed + free_cash + overlay (all below)
cip_revenue_financed_assumption: 6.6% CIP Financing Policy: 2.30% of prior-year Net Revenue (Total Revenue - Debt Exclusions - Free Cash - Non-Appropriations), per FY2027 Financial Plan p.352/384 - see methodology doc (realized FY27-32 average, target 2.1%)
cip_free_cash_assumption: 6.6% CIP Financing Policy: 2.89% of prior-year Net Revenue (Total Revenue - Debt Exclusions - Free Cash - Non-Appropriations), per FY2027 Financial Plan p.352/384 - see methodology doc (realized FY27-32 average - Free Cash's own CIP allocation; combined with debt+revenue-financed this tops the total to the Town's real 8% CIP funding target - see Free Cash Policy in methodology doc)
cip_overlay_surplus_assumption: held at $0 - Overlay Surplus is explicitly one-time/non-recurring, not extended
